name: Allen & Heath Avantis
notes: Community module for Avantis consoles over MIDI over TCP (README) with optional AH-Net state sync. All actions of src/actions.ts (UpdateActions) and all feedbacks of src/feedbacks.ts (UpdateFeedbacks) are catalogued (the actions marked in availability are only registered when the config option rackUfxInstalled is on).

Most actions are created by builder functions (muteActionBuilder, faderActionBuilder, relativeFaderActionBuilder, sendLevelActionBuilder, assignActionBuilder in src/actions.ts) once per strip type; each generated action is catalogued separately with the same option pattern, so there are 13 mute, 12 fader and 12 relative fader actions for the standard strip types plus 2 + 2 + 2 for RackUltraFX.

Strip dropdown ids are the MIDI channel numbers of the console (offset per strip type, for example input ids 0..63, stereo groups 64..83, DCAs 54..69, main mixes 48..50); labels are numbered from 1. Long lists (inputs 64, scenes 500) are not enumerated: the option has valueType number, min, max and a choicesNote. The number of inputs and buses grows with the D-Pack option (96 inputs, 54 mono and 27 stereo buses; getChannelCapacities in src/config.ts).
The fader level dropdown uses the 74 discrete values of src/fader.json (ids are MIDI values, 0 = -inf, 127 = +10 dB); they are summarised in choicesNote, not listed.

The mute dropdown accepts a custom value matching /^(mute|unmute|toggle|true|false)$/ (allowCustom). Legacy actions (send_input_to, send_input_to_fx_return) are kept for saved 1.x configurations and do nothing useful on Avantis; they are catalogued as is.
The six MMC transport actions are created in a loop over MMC_TRANSPORT_CHOICES (Stop, Play, Fast Forward, Rewind, Record, Pause); the ids are mmc_ + the lower-case label with underscores.
Built on @companion-module/base 2.0.4 (2.x): option values support expressions; the module also resolves variables in the textinput fields itself.
Not catalogued: config fields, variables and presets.
